rule.small: Delegate source area<=2304 default candidate rule from N04.
rule.middle: Area2305..16384 starts unique-colour limit area>>3, scans every row. A row adding no colours subtracts width from remaining area; remaining<2305 sets no-sharpen and exits, otherwise limit becomes remaining>>4. Stop when distinct count exceeds current limit.
rule.large: Area>16384 samples every sixth row, initial limit20, with no remaining-area adjustment.
rule.colour: Convert to RGB; if R==B, mask lowest2bits of all three channels even when G differs. Alpha excluded.
rule.final: Distinct<20 sets no-sharpen. Limit20 clears input-fixup iff distinct>20. Other limits clear fixup iff distinct>20 OR distinct<=limit. Default net shrink clears no-sharpen later.
rule.filter: Same independently checked Q13 mixed stage core, with full/partial input fixup as selected.

storage.proof: All native input RGBA samples retained with source stored hashes. Case complete stored buffer and normalized RGBA SHA256 retained; expected raw outputs remain in75MB D acquisition, reproducible by owned producer. No sampled output hash or omitted alpha/padding.

limitations: Mixed full positive rectangles/default truecolor/current-host source only.
Other profiles/flags, clip/mirror/indexed formats and large nonmixed behavior not closed.
Not product C# HALFTONE or source composed integration.
Original vendor runtime, PC project corpus, physical devices and all feature rows stay open.
